candidateRule: For AQ taxonomy indexing only, use Q as primary when the defined PDP-0 outcome is a bounded observation of declared profiles, capabilities, processing options, compatibility, or capability-scoped readiness and does not execute, render, publish, or distribute. Add P or O as related only when the capability or parent requirement explicitly includes that delivery or review/quality/compliance outcome. Resolve each related-cluster link separately against the exact output contract.
candidateRuleRationale: This applies existing blueprint meanings for P (render/publish/distribute), Q (operations/API/agents), and O (review/quality/compliance) to current observation-only outcomes. It adds no capability, requirement, acceptance case, taxonomy cluster, or execution/admission claim.

currentRecommendedMapping.semanticRationale: The taxonomy has no dedicated processing-profile discovery cluster; Q is the closest operational fit because this is an eligibility/selection operation, not proof that a profile is admitted.

affectedRows.currentOutcome: Discover declared profile definitions and return the exact profile/catalog observation supported by the source; discovery reports declarations and does not admit execution.
affectedRows.ownerQuestion: For profile-catalog discovery, should Q remain primary with P and O as related indexes, given the outcome is a bounded observation of declared profiles and does not admit execution?

currentRecommendedMapping.semanticRationale: The taxonomy has no dedicated profile-validation cluster; Q is the closest operational fit because compatibility is checked as an execution option, not a publishing guarantee.

affectedRows.currentOutcome: Evaluate one named output profile against an explicit outcome and input constraints, returning per-dimension compatibility and blockers without executing delivery.
affectedRows.ownerQuestion: For non-executing profile compatibility validation, should Q remain primary and P related, given the outcome reports per-dimension compatibility without delivering or publishing?

currentRecommendedMapping.semanticRationale: The taxonomy has no standalone capability-registry cluster; Q is the closest fit for capability discovery as an operational/API concern.

affectedRows.currentOutcome: Discover declared capability leaves and their source-declared metadata, returning an observation of the requested catalog scope.
affectedRows.ownerQuestion: For declared capability-catalog discovery, should Q remain primary with O related, and what exact review/evidence outcome, if any, justifies the O cross-link?

currentRecommendedMapping.semanticRationale: The taxonomy has no standalone option-registry cluster; Q is the closest fit for checking declared operational options.

affectedRows.currentOutcome: A caller can check declared processing options and their capability evidence; current runtime readiness remains a separate check.
affectedRows.ownerQuestion: For declared processing-option and evidence inspection, should Q remain primary with O related, and is the evidence merely observed or reviewed as a quality/compliance decision?

currentRecommendedMapping.semanticRationale: The taxonomy has no standalone execution-compatibility cluster; Q is the closest fit for a bounded orchestration preflight.

affectedRows.currentOutcome: Compare a declared capability query with the requested operation and profile, returning a declared-capability-and-compatibility result as an observation only.
affectedRows.ownerQuestion: For observational execution-compatibility preflight, should Q remain primary with O related, and does the intended result include a distinct review decision beyond comparison of declared inputs?

currentRecommendedMapping.semanticRationale: Readiness is not a promised capability in any single A–Q feature cluster; Q is the closest operational fit for reporting capability-scoped readiness.

affectedRows.currentOutcome: Inspect readiness for the requested capability scope and return a capability-scoped readiness observation, preserving the boundary and source of each observed check.
affectedRows.ownerQuestion: For capability-scoped readiness observation, should Q remain primary with O related, or should O be primary; which exact readiness evidence is intended as review/quality/compliance disposition?

sourceDeltaIfAdopted: None until the authentic owner selects an option. If adopted, create a separate append-only AQ recommendation successor recording the rule and row-level disposition; do not edit capabilities.yaml, requirements.yaml, the 501-row crosswalk, or phase status from this candidate.
